predecessor_boundary: The prior own-symbol top-of-book/trade OCO primary run was hard-invalid and its post-outcome accounting diagnostic had zero survivors. This claim does not retune its thresholds. It changes the primary information source to multi-level Bybit L2 queue state and uses one fixed model and three payoff cells.
related_negative_result: RES-20260726-BYBIT-L2-RESILIENCY-FATAL-001 tested directional executable-return prediction with taker entry and failed. This claim changes both the prediction target to direction-neutral movement hazard and the payoff to a symmetric conditional-entry pair.
scope: One fixed HistGradientBoosting movement-hazard model on completed 100ms Bybit BTCUSDT top-five L2 and trade state. The model predicts only whether a 40bp absolute midpoint first passage is imminent. A single extreme score threshold arms one symmetric pair of independent buy-stop and sell-stop market entries; realized price delivery chooses direction. The study models acknowledgment, trigger-to-fill, non-atomic cancellation, same-bin double trigger, adverse executable exits, one global slot and identical 12/18/24bp paths.
